slides.title: US Embassy alert for Ethiopia
slides.body: What it told US citizens this month

slides.title: Possible long-range attacks
slides.body: The embassy said it is aware of reports of possible long-range attacks on Ethiopian military installations.

slides.title: Do not travel to Amhara, Tigray or Afar
slides.body: US citizens there were told to leave if it is safe, or to shelter in place.

slides.title: Beware false reports
slides.body: The embassy warned of false and misleading social media reports about the security situation, and urged people to check reliable sources.

slides.title: Stay informed. Verify before you share.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Anadolu Agency, Oct 7, 2026; Fox News, Oct 14, 2026
